# Deny-by-default management filter (mgmt-acl mode strict; Junos only).
# The filter accepts every protocol from the sources of the mgmt-acl list (an entry with
# services keeps only those) and has no default-accept term: the implicit discard at the
# end of a Junos filter drops the rest.
# Once the filter is applied to lo0, these stop reaching the routing engine:
#   - routing protocols from neighbours that are not in the list: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, VRRP, LDP
#   - replies from servers that are not in the list: TACACS+ and RADIUS (the server this walkthrough
#     names is in it), NTP, DNS
#   - NTP, syslog and DHCP from hosts that are not in the list
#   - SNMP from sources outside the list
#   - every other protocol (ping, traceroute) from sources outside the list
# permit-mgmt starts with the address tacctl reaches the device from and, when it is another one
# (--server, a RADIUS listener bound to another address), the address the device authenticates against.
# Add each neighbour and server the device needs first ('tacctl scope mgmt-acl lab add <cidr>').
# Keep a console session open while you apply it, and commit with 'commit confirmed'.
# These 'set firewall' lines define the filter in the candidate config.
# Activate it by uncommenting the 'set interfaces lo0 …' line below
# after reviewing.
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.1/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.0.0.0/8
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-any from source-address 192.0.2.64/26
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-any from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-any then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-22 from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-22 from source-address 203.0.113.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-22 from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-22 from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-tcp-22 then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-123 from source-address 192.0.2.64/26
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-123 from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-123 from destination-port ntp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-123 then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-161-162 from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-161-162 from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-161-162 from destination-port 161-162
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-udp-161-162 then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-icmp from source-address 203.0.113.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-icmp from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-icmp then accept
#
# A source that has services is accepted for those only: ssh needs tcp/22 among them and
# NETCONF (Step 6) tcp/830; a source without services has every port.
#
# Apply (review first):
# set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input MGMT-ACL
